newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Big SPX trades highlight slow day.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Big SPX trades highlight slow day.

text.p: Big institutional trades in S&P 500 stock index .SPX options highlighted an otherwise moribund index options session, traders said Friday.
Traders said Morgan Stanley in early activity did a January 705/745 put spread 6,000 times for 5-1/2 points.
Salomon Brothers did a type of butterfly in the January 710, 720 and 740 puts, which traded 3,000, 4,000 and 1,150 contracts, respectively, traders said.
"They do these quite a bit," one trader said of the big volume spreads. Index options trading was otherwise subdued, he said.
The underlying SPX index was down nearly a point at about 755 at 1430 CST/2030 GMT after rising to 758.75 in morning actiivty.
Trading in the S&P 100 stock index .OEX was particularly lackluster as the underlying index traded in a narrow band, traders said.
In late trading, the OEX was at a new session low, down 0.81 at 734.79. It had reached a session peak of 738.13.
An OEX options trader in Chicago said most institutional and retail investors had closed their books for the year, and most trading was from locals and fund managers.
"I think a lot of what is going on is window dressing," he said.
At year-end, fund managers often "window dress" their portfolios by buying the year's best-performing stocks.
Among OEX options, the January 735 put and call and the January 755 call were vying for the most active, each having traded more than 2,400 contracts by 1440 CST/2040 GMT.
Other popular OEX options included the January 765 call, the January 690 put and the January 750 call. ((-G.Crawford, 312 408 8750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
